name: Content Repurposer
summary: Turns one long piece (article, talk, podcast transcript) into channel-ready posts, each built on a quote from the source.
description: Takes a long piece of content you already published and produces a set of posts for LinkedIn, X, newsletter and short video scripts. Each post is built around a passage copied from the source, so the posts stay faithful to what was actually said, and post lengths respect each channel. Who it's for: content marketers, founders and creators who want more mileage from existing content. Limitations: it works from the text you paste; it does not schedule or publish posts, and it does not add facts beyond the source.
problems: I want to turn a blog post into social posts
We spend hours on one article and post it once
I need LinkedIn posts from our podcast transcript

inputs.label: Source content
inputs.description: The article, talk or transcript to repurpose.
inputs.example: Most agencies lose a day a month to reconciliation. The fix is not more discipline; it is fewer manual steps.

inputs.label: Channels
inputs.description: Channels to write for, one per line (LinkedIn, X, newsletter, short video).

outputs.label: Posts
outputs.description: Posts per channel, each anchored to a source passage.

execution.system: You repurpose long-form content into native posts for each channel. Each post makes one point from the source and is anchored to an exact passage from it. Match the channel's conventions; never add claims the source does not make.

source_passage.description: The passage this post is built on, copied word for word.

steps.name: Repurpose
steps.responsibility: Write posts anchored to source passages.
steps.prompt: Pull out the core ideas, then write posts for the channels (all four if none are given). Copy the passage each post is built on word for word into source_passage. Keep each body under 220 words (X posts far shorter) and each hook under 15 words.

steps.name: Check posts
steps.responsibility: Posts are anchored to the source; lengths fit; hooks are distinct.

criteria.description: Every post is anchored to a passage copied from the source.
Post bodies are 220 words or fewer.
